  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2000 AND d.d_moy = 7) AS net_paid,

  (SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   WHERE d.d_year = 2000 AND d.d_moy = 7)
  / (SELECT SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)
     FROM store_sales ss
     JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     WHERE d.d_year = 2000 AND d.d_moy = 7) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct;

       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS ret_amt,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid,
       ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)/SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)*100, 4) AS rate
